name: gitlab
description: GitLab (Omnibus in a container): uses 'gitlab-backup create' for a consistent internal dump, backs up the stack folder WITHOUT the live data, and cleans up the internal dump afterwards. DB auto-detection is off (GitLab dumps itself).

pre_backup.cmd: rm -f gitlab/data/backups/*_gitlab_backup.tar && docker exec gitlab gitlab-backup create CRON=1
pre_backup.name: gitlab-backup create

restore.cmd: backup_dir=gitlab/data/backups; set -- "$backup_dir"/*_gitlab_backup.tar; if [ "$#" -ne 1 ] || [ ! -f "$1" ] || [ -L "$1" ]; then echo "Expected exactly one regular GitLab backup archive in $backup_dir; found $#." >&2; exit 1; fi; archive=${1##*/}; backup=${archive%_gitlab_backup.tar}; case "$backup" in ""|*[!A-Za-z0-9_.-]*) echo "Unsafe GitLab backup ID: $backup" >&2; exit 1;; esac; reconfigure_attempt=0; reconfigure_idle=0; while [ "$reconfigure_idle" -lt 3 ]; do running=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' gitlab 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$running" != true ]; then echo "GitLab container stopped before initial reconfigure completed." >&2; docker logs --tail 300 gitlab >&2 || true; exit 1; fi; probe=$(docker exec gitlab sh -c "pgrep -f '[c]inc-client|[c]hef-client|[g]itlab-ctl reconfigure' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo busy || echo idle" 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$probe" = idle ]; then reconfigure_idle=$((reconfigure_idle + 1)); else reconfigure_idle=0; fi; if [ "$reconfigure_idle" -ge 3 ]; then echo "GitLab initial reconfigure completed."; break; fi; reconfigure_attempt=$((reconfigure_attempt + 1)); if [ "$reconfigure_attempt" -ge 90 ]; then echo "GitLab initial reconfigure did not complete successfully within 30 minutes." >&2; docker logs --tail 300 gitlab >&2 || true; exit 1; fi; echo "Waiting for GitLab initial reconfigure ($reconfigure_attempt/90)..."; sleep 20; done; ready_passes=0; ready_attempt=0; while [ "$ready_passes" -lt 2 ]; do running=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' gitlab 2>/dev/null || true); if [ "$running" != true ]; then echo "GitLab container stopped during readiness checks." >&2; docker logs --tail 300 gitlab >&2 || true; exit 1; fi; ready_attempt=$((ready_attempt + 1)); if docker exec gitlab /opt/gitlab/bin/gitlab-healthcheck --fail --max-time 10 >/dev/null 2>&1 && docker exec gitlab gitlab-rake gitlab:env:info >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready_passes=$((ready_passes + 1)); echo "GitLab readiness pass $ready_passes/2 succeeded."; if [ "$ready_passes" -lt 2 ]; then sleep 10; fi; else ready_passes=0; if [ "$ready_attempt" -ge 90 ]; then echo "GitLab did not pass health and Rails checks twice within 30 minutes." >&2; docker logs --tail 300 gitlab >&2 || true; exit 1; fi; echo "Waiting for GitLab health and Rails readiness ($ready_attempt/90)..."; sleep 20; fi; done && docker exec gitlab gitlab-ctl stop puma && docker exec gitlab gitlab-ctl stop sidekiq && docker exec -e GITLAB_ASSUME_YES=1 gitlab gitlab-backup restore BACKUP="$backup"
restore.name: gitlab-backup restore
